A little about me.

I’m a Master of Design student at NIFT Bengaluru with a background in English Literature and an interest in understanding how people interact with the world around them.

Experience

  • Freelance Graphic Designer, Sri Sri Tattva (Aug 2026 – present)
  • Branding & Marketing Design Intern, Sri Sri Tattva (Jun – Jul 2026)
  • Illustration & graphic design for independent music artists

Education

  • M.Des, NIFT Bangalore (2025 – 27)
  • B.A. English Language & Literature, Mahatma Gandhi University (2020 – 23)

Achievements

  • ICoRD ’26: research contribution accepted
  • NSS State Award (2019 – 20)
  • National Integration Camp, State representative

Certifications

  • Google: Foundations of User Experience (UX) Design
  • Google: Start the UX Design Process

Research & projects

  • Usability study of G Pay for senior citizens (NIFT, 2025)
  • India Post: shorter parcel-booking queues

I believe good design should make sense, work beautifully, and bring a little joy into people’s lives.

I’m always curious about how things work, why people behave the way they do, and how thoughtful design can make everyday experiences better.

Making sense of complexity. Bringing joy to the experience.
